To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have developed a Petri net language that supports the two classes of monitoring Petri nets, that we have designed a software tool that supports the Petri net language, and that we have implemented a Petri net player that supports the two kinds Petri nets.
Exhost-PIPE supports a wide variety of Petri nets (particle and plan Petri net), it is an open platform (plug-in architecture) that can be extended by the user and it is available on the web.
Exhost-PIPE, an extended version of PIPE, supports particle Petri nets, plan Petri nets, and a new Petri net player.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of new Petri net models for the modelling and analysis of distributed systems.
the design of a new kind of Petri nets that we call monitoring Petri nets.
the development of a software environment that supports the specification and the simulation of a large family of Petri net models.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Exhost-PIPE is a software tool that can be used as a general purpose Petri net editor and player for the two classes of Petri nets presented here.
Exhost-PIPE is a very useful tool for the modelling of systems with a large number of concurrent processes.
Exhost-PIPE is a very powerful tool for the analysis and simulation of Petri nets.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Exhost-PIPESuite is now a complete and flexible tool that allows the user to design, analyze and simulate a wide class of Petri nets.
Exhost-PIPE is a software that allows the designer to specify and analyze models of complex systems in an easy, intuitive and efficient way.
Exhost-PIPE is a powerful tool for modelling, simulating, analysing and visualising Petri net systems.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Exhost-PIP software is now a complete and powerful tool for modelling and simulating Petri nets.
the Exhost-PIPES software is a powerful and flexible tool for simulating and analysing a wide range of models.
the Exhost-PIPE software can be used as a platform for the development of new algorithms.
